text.tspan: Figure 1: No capacity estimate lowered day-ahead solar error detectably
at 6 plants, and the Kalman filter raised it at the primary setting

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in an XGBoost forecast's mean absolute error when its training power is divided by an estimate of each plant's capacity, against B0, which divides by the plant's static capacity and has an error of 8.93 points of capacity. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval over the 18 scored months. Dashed lines: 2% of B0's error (0.179 points), the smallest change the plan counted as worth acting on. Planned: written into the plan before any result existed. Post hoc: designed after the results. Hollow triangle: the second XGBoost setting. B0: baseline, dividing by the static capacity. KF pick: the Kalman filter, which the plan's rule chose. Capacity- only ref.: B0's forecast times each plant-month's output relative to its neighbours, with no fit. HYST: hold at static until a drop lasts 7 days. HM: hidden Markov. PR: performance ratio. CX2: convex, direct and alternating current. NR: neighbour ratio. DSKF: deseasonalised Kalman filter. DP1: differentiable physics. Rows below HYST ran at the primary setting only. CX1, a post hoc convex estimator, is off the scale at +3.222 [+2.380, +4.238].'
text.tspan: Change in an XGBoost forecast's mean absolute error when its training power is divided by an estimate of each
plant's capacity, against B0, which divides by the plant's static capacity and has an error of 8.93 points of
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval over the 18 scored months. Dashed lines: 2% of B0's error (0.179 points), the
smallest change the plan counted as worth acting on. Planned: written into the plan before any result existed. Post
hoc: designed after the results. Hollow triangle: the second XGBoost setting.
B0: baseline, dividing by the static capacity. KF pick: the Kalman filter, which the plan's rule chose. Capacity-
only ref.: B0's forecast times each plant-month's output relative to its neighbours, with no fit. HYST: hold at
static until a drop lasts 7 days. HM: hidden Markov. PR: performance ratio. CX2: convex, direct and alternating
current. NR: neighbour ratio. DSKF: deseasonalised Kalman filter. DP1: differentiable physics. Rows below HYST ran
at the primary setting only. CX1, a post hoc convex estimator, is off the scale at +3.222 [+2.380, +4.238].
